evidence: The chemical bonding of AZO films on Si was evaluated by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The physical thickness of films was estimated using an ellipsometer. Sheet resistances of AZO films were measured by the standard four-probe method. Crystallinity and phase structures of the films were analyzed by a Rigaku-D/MAX 2000 XRD system. The microstructure and morphology were examined by AFM. The optical transmission was measured by a UV-Vis spectrophotometer.
